title: RTX 5080 Tested: Discussing Hardware, Benchmarks, DLSS 4 & More
description:
Nvidia's GeForce RTX 5080 has arrived and in this video Adam and Will talk about the hardware, the testing, multi frame generation, benchmark results compared to the RTX 4080 Super, RX 7900 XTX, and more.

Test bench configuration:
CPU - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D
AIO - Corsair iCue H115i RGB Elite 280mm at 100% fan speed
Mobo - Asus ProArt X870E-Creator WiFi
DRAM - Patriot Viper Venom 32GB (2x16) DDR5 6000MT/s
SSD - Crucial T700 2TB Gen 5
PSU - SilverStone Hela 1200R Platinum

Windows configuration:
Version - 24H2 Build 26.100.2454
VBS - On
Power - Best Performance
iGPU - Disabled
ReBAR - On

GPU driver versions:
Nvidia xx90 GPUs - 571.86
Nvidia xx80 GPUs - 572.02
AMD - 24.12.1
